resale_co.name: Certificate of Continued Occupancy (Resale Certificate of Occupancy)
resale_co.issued_by: Beachwood Borough Division of Code Enforcement/Housing (Construction, Land Use and Zoning office)
resale_co.lead_time: Submit the resale application about 60 days before closing
requirements: Receipt from a licensed HVAC professional showing the heating system works (not needed for electric heat)
Well water: Ocean County Health Department water analysis certificate
Wood-burning fireplace: receipt from a licensed professional showing the chimney is in working order
Electrical service panel has covers and working breakers; all lights, outlets and switches work with cover plates
GFCI outlets within 6 feet of any water source and in basements, garages and outside
Driveway and walkways free of trip hazards; lawn, hedges and trees trimmed and debris removed
Roof, siding, gutters and downspouts in good repair; a gutter over steps
Screens in windows and entry doors; windows unbroken, working and stay up when opened
3 inch house numbers visible on the home or both sides of the mailbox
Handrails on all stairs and guardrails on open sides
Pool properly safeguarded with bonded metal parts and self-closing, self-latching gates
Garage door opener with no extension cords or adapters; doors working and undamaged
Floors, walls and ceilings in good condition; stove burners and oven work
Hot and cold running water with no leaks and drains that drain freely; basement lit, ventilated and not overly damp
Owner or an authorized adult representative must be present for the inspection

fees.quote: Certificate of Continued Occupancy / Rental Permit: $100

fees.label: Resale housing application fee (resale packet)
fees.quote: Housing application fee is $100.00.  If the initial inspection fails the re-inspection fee is $50.00.

fees.label: Transfer of Title (property not expected to pass resale inspection): fire inspection only
fees.quote: A Transfer of Title requires a fire inspection only. The inspection fee is $30.00. If the initial inspection fails, a re-inspection fee of $30.00 will apply.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Resale Application Packet (the whole application must be complete) and attach the heating, well and chimney paperwork that applies. Submit it by email to Meredith Triolo (mtriolo@beachwoodusa.com), in person at the Municipal Office, or by mail to Borough of Beachwood, Attn: Meredith Triolo, 1600 Pinewald Road, Beachwood, NJ 08722. After review a payment link is emailed; in-person payment is exact cash or check payable to Borough of Beachwood. Fees are non-refundable. Housing and Fire Prevention Bureau inspections are then scheduled for a Tuesday or Wednesday, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. If the home will not pass, a Transfer of Title application (fire inspection only, plus a notarized buyer letter that no one will occupy the home until a full resale inspection is passed) lets the sale proceed.

requirements: Smoke alarms on every level including the basement and outside each sleeping area
Homes built before 1977: 10-year sealed battery smoke alarms on each level, within 10 feet of all bedrooms
Homes built January 1, 1977 to February 21, 1983: hardwired alarms on sleeping levels and in the basement, 10-year sealed battery alarms on other levels
Homes built February 22, 1983 to April 30, 1993: interconnected hardwired alarms with battery backup on every level; May 1, 1993 and later also inside every bedroom
Hardwired alarms must not be replaced with battery alarms; renovation-era rules apply to renovated homes
Carbon monoxide alarms within 10 feet of all bedrooms if the home has fuel-burning appliances or an attached garage (UL-2034, battery, hardwired or plug-in)
Homes with a fire alarm system must provide a contractor's inspection report; the Borough does not test fire alarm systems
Homes with a generator, solar panels or battery storage need a printed CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER label within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and electric meter
Portable fire extinguishers are no longer required (as of February 3, 2025), although the older application page in the packet still lists one

authorities.name: Borough of Beachwood Bureau of Fire Prevention
authorities.lead_time: Schedule in advance; the fire inspection is done with the housing inspection on a Tuesday or Wednesday, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. The certificate is valid for 6 months.

fees.label: Smoke alarm and carbon monoxide alarm inspection
Certificate of Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm and Portable Fire Extinguisher Compliance, initial inspection (2025 sheet)

authorities.how_to_apply: The fire application is part of the Borough's Resale Application Packet (or the Transfer of Title application) submitted to the Construction/Zoning office; to schedule, contact the Bureau of Fire Prevention at (732) 286-6000 for application paperwork.

evidence.quote: If you are selling, leasing, or changing the occupancy of any one- or two-family home or attached single-family dwelling in Beachwood, you must obtain a Certificate of Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm, and Portable Fire Extinguisher Compliance (CSACMAPFEC).
The CSACMAPFEC is valid for six (6) months from the date of issuance.
Failure to obtain a certificate before closing may result in a fine of up to $500.
To schedule an inspection, contact the Bureau of Fire Prevention at (732) 286-6000 for application paperwork.
As of February 3, 2025, portable fire extinguishers are no longer required to obtain a CSACMAPFEC in Beachwood.
Fire application fee is $30.  If the initial inspection fails the re-inspection fee is $30.00.
The required Housing Inspection and Fire Prevention Bureau Inspection will be scheduled as part of the approval process.

fire_cert.notes: Beachwood is its own fire code enforcing agency (registry code M) through the Borough Bureau of Fire Prevention. Fees agree across the Construction/Zoning page, the resale packet and the Bureau's February 2025 sheet: $30 inspection, $30 re-inspection. The fire application form inside the packets still shows the old extinguisher checkbox, but the Bureau's 2025 sheet says extinguishers are no longer required. The state directory prints the Fire Official's email as 'rfosterfirebureau@beachwoodusa.co', which looks cut off, so no email is given; the Borough site does not list a Fire Bureau email. The fire application form also prints a second phone number that is hard to read on the scan, so only (732) 286-6000 is used. The Beachwood Volunteer Fire Company's own website is separate from the Bureau.
